mapper.sql: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c WHERE c.target_type=1 AND c.target_id=#{postId} AND c.status=1 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND (c.parent_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM comment root WHERE root.id=c.parent_id AND root.parent_id IS NULL AND root.target_id=c.target_id AND root.target_type=1 AND ((root.status=1 AND root.deleted_at IS NULL) OR (root.status IN(3,4) AND c.community_thread=TRUE)))))
